test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets.**

She was wearing a ______ new outfit. (expensive)
solution: The correct answer is '**cheap**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**expensive**' is '**cheap**'. • **Expensive**: costing a lot of money. (ख़र्चीला, बहुत महँगा, क़ीमती) • *Example: Keeping a horse is **expensive**.* • **Cheap**: low in price, costing little money. (सस्‍ता, कम क़ीमत का) • *Example: Oranges are **cheap** at the moment.* **​Correct Answer:__** *cheap.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **costly**: costing a lot of money; expensive. (बड़ी लागत वाला; महँगा, क़ीमती) • **premium**: an amount of money that you pay regularly to a company for insurance against accidents, damage, etc. (दुर्घटना, क्षति आदि के बीमा के लिए किसी कंपनी को दी गई नियमित रक़म; बीमे की क़िस्‍त) • **precious**: of great value (usually because it is rare or difficult to find). [क़ीमती, बहुमूल्‍य (सामान्‍यतः दुर्लभ होने के कारण)] 34:T75f, The correct answer is *'The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.'*
